title: Solo Leveling: Arise Overdrive Game Launches for PS5, Xbox Series X|S on November 3
content: Netmarble announced on Wednesday that its Solo Leveling : ARISE OVERDRIVE action role-playing game will launch on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S on November 3. The game launched for PC via Steam and Xbox PC in November 2025. The game adapts the story of the original webtoon and also features 4-player gameplay.
author: ANN

title: Rainbow Days' Minami Mizuno Launches New Fujikawa Minori wa Erabenai. Manga
content: The December issue of Shueisha 's Cocohana magazine announced on Wednesday that Minami Mizuno will launch a new manga titled Fujikawa Minori wa Erabenai . ( Minori Fujikawa Cannot Choose .), which will launch in the magazine's next issue on November 28.

title: 'Nijiiro Days' Creator Launches New Manga
content: Manga creator Minami Mizuno announced on X (formerly Twitter) on Wednesday that she will launch a new manga, Fujikawa Minori wa Erabenai. , in the Cocohana magazine. The January 2027 issue will publish the first chapter on November 28.

title: Attack on Titan Director Breaks Silence on Eren’s Voice After 13 Years
content: The voice behind Eren Yeager has been iconic ever since the anime debut, and the director finally reveals why. Even several years after the main story’s ending, the popularity of Attack on Titan only keeps increasing.
author: ComicBook

title: Sachiko Uguisu's Kaikai Gigigigigi Manga Ends
content: Futabasha 's Comic Action platform published the final chapter of Sachiko Uguisu 's Kaikai Gigigigigi manga on Tuesday. The series follows a trio of high school students who dive into the mysteries of Kaminari City's strange K-Zone, where strange phenomena are said to occur.
author: ANN

title: Bleach Creator Finally Addresses His Influence on Demon Slayer and Jujutsu Kaisen
content: More than 22 years after its anime debut, Bleach has finally reached its conclusion with the Thousand-Year Blood War Arc. The anime released its final part as part of the Summer 2026 lineup and reached its conclusion after a major delay.
author: ComicBook

title: The Full-Time Wife Escapist's Tsunami Umino Launches New Manga in December
content: The December issue of Hakusensha 's Melody magazine announced on Wednesday that it will launch a serialization of Tsunami Umino 's previous one-shot manga Omiai Tantei Katabiranotsuji Nagi (Matchmaking Detective Nagi Katabiranotsuji) in the magazine's February 2027 issue on December 25.
author: ANN
